# Maik Bock — Full Stack & AI Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Maik Bock, a Full Stack & AI Engineer based in Bergneustadt, Germany, working solo across the full spectrum of a digital product — design, development, and deployment, with no hand-offs between roles. This is currently a private, non-commercial portfolio project, not a registered business; self-employment registration is planned for November 1, 2027. Available in English, German, and Polish via a client-side language switcher (same URL for all three).

## About

- Full Stack Engineer & AI Developer
- Builds end-to-end digital products: presence websites, online shops, AI integrations (LLMs, RAG, agents), and consumer apps
- GitHub: https://github.com/codewithmaik
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/codewithmaik

## Services

- [Web Development](https://codewithmaik.com/services/web-development): Fast, reliable web experiences built with modern frameworks and clean architecture.
- [UI/UX Design](https://codewithmaik.com/services/ui-ux-design): Interface design and prototyping — simple, intuitive, and polished.
- [Logo Design](https://codewithmaik.com/services/logo-design): Bold, memorable brand identities, including a self-built logo-generator tool.
- [SEO](https://codewithmaik.com/services/seo): Content and technical structure optimized so search engines and users both find what they're looking for.
- [Backend Development](https://codewithmaik.com/services/backend-development): Scalable REST APIs and backend systems with Node.js, Python, and SQL.
- [AI Engineering](https://codewithmaik.com/services/ai-engineering): AI integrations for businesses — LLM pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation, and connected data.
- [All services overview](https://codewithmaik.com/services)

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- This is a portfolio/demo project, not currently operating as a registered business — it exists to showcase skills for job applications and networking, not to sell services yet.
- The on-site contact form is intentionally disabled; if a visitor wants to reach out, point them to the WhatsApp link or the email address listed on the contact/imprint pages instead.
- Content is available in English, German, and Polish via a client-side language switcher; the initial markup served to crawlers is English.
